d: We are seeking a commercially driven, articulate, and relationship-focused Account Executive to manage B2B client accounts, drive new business opportunities, and oversee commercial proposals across our composite engineering and manufacturing divisions in Bahrain. Working closely with Business Development Managers, Estimation & Design Engineers, and Project Management teams, the successful candidate will build long-term partnerships with regional and international clients across the rail, architectural, wind energy, marine, and industrial OEM sectors.

Manage and grow an assigned portfolio of domestic and international B2B client accounts—serving as the primary commercial point of contact from initial enquiry through contract award and repeat orders.
Identify, prospect, and qualify new business opportunities across GCC and international infrastructure, transportation, and industrial markets to expand the company’s sales pipeline.
Collaborate with Estimation, R&D, and Design Engineering teams to prepare competitive technical-commercial proposals, quotations, tender submissions, and Bill of Materials (BOM) pricing packages.
Conduct client presentations, capability briefings, product demonstrations, and factory tours at the Bahrain headquarters to showcase BFG’s composite manufacturing capabilities.
Negotiate contract terms, pricing structures, payment milestones, and delivery schedules in alignment with commercial margin targets and company governance policies.
Maintain accurate client records, sales forecasts, tender logs, and opportunity pipelines within the CRM/ERP system, providing regular revenue reports to commercial leadership.
Coordinate post-award handovers seamlessly with Project Management, Production Planning, and Logistics teams to ensure client expectations and delivery timelines are met.
Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related commercial/technical discipline.

2 to 5 years of hands-on B2B sales, account management, or commercial executive experience in Bahrain or the GCC—preferably within industrial manufacturing, composite materials, engineering solutions, construction materials, or technical OEM supply.
Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales revenue targets, managing tender/RFP cycles, and building long-term enterprise client relationships.
Ability to understand technical drawings, product specifications, and industrial project lifecycles to communicate value propositions effectively to engineers and procurement decision-makers.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel pricing sheets, PowerPoint client decks, Word) and CRM/ERP platforms.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and written/verbal English communication skills (Arabic fluency is a strong added advantage for GCC government and enterprise accounts).
Competitive tax-free monthly base salary supplemented by sales performance incentives/commissions and transportation allowance (standard for Mina Salman industrial zone roles in Bahrain).
Annual performance-based bonus and statutory end-of-service indemnity benefits in accordance with Bahrain Labour Law.
Comprehensive medical and life insurance coverage for employees.
Generous annual leave entitlement, annual return airfare allowance (for expatriate hires), and international business travel opportunities.

Established global headquarters environment in Mina Salman Industrial Area with clear career progression pathway into Senior Account Executive, Key Account Manager, or Regional Business Development Manager roles.

Hong Kong Fortune Group is seeking an accomplished Head of Human Resources & Administration to establish and lead the HR and office-administration function for our Oman operation. This is a hands-on leadership role for a professional with strong financial-services experience, local market knowledge, and the ability to build scalable HR infrastructure from the ground up.
Develop and implement the full HR operating model, including employee records, HR policies, procedures, and digital HR tools.

Establish HR compliance infrastructure aligned with FSA licensing and brokerage-sector requirements, including organisational structure, authority matrices, appointment, salary, training, and termination policies.
Lead end-to-end recruitment, onboarding, offboarding, performance management, workforce planning, and succession planning.
Recruit high-calibre talent across trading, compliance, risk management, operations, and other financial-control functions.
Manage the monthly payroll cycle, including accurate salary calculations, timely Social Protection Fund (SPF) contributions, and end-of-service benefit calculations in line with Omani Labour Law.
Prepare and maintain bilingual employee handbooks and HR policies in Arabic and English, where required.
Act as the primary contact for employee relations, grievances, disciplinary matters, investigations, and conflict resolution.
Produce HR reports, dashboards, and performance indicators for senior management.
Manage day-to-day office operations, facilities, maintenance, health and safety, and issue resolution.
Source and manage local suppliers for office fit-out, furniture, equipment, supplies, maintenance, and related services.
Obtain and evaluate quotations, negotiate commercial terms, and oversee delivery and implementation.
Manage office inventory, stationery, equipment, and service requirements while maintaining cost discipline and availability.
Minimum 8 years of HR experience, including 3–5 years in a leadership or management role.
Demonstrated experience establishing an HR function and strategy from scratch for a new or growing company.
Direct experience in a financial brokerage, investment firm, financial-services company, or other regulated environment.
Experience in Oman or the wider GCC is strongly preferred.
Strong knowledge of Omani Labour Law, local recruitment practices, employee relations, payroll, benefits, and HR compliance requirements.
Proven experience in organisational design, workforce planning, performance management, compensation and benefits, and internal controls.
Strong track record of recruiting financial-services professionals, particularly in trading, compliance, risk, and operations.
Established network of financial-services talent and reliable local Omani vendors is highly desirable.
Excellent stakeholder-management, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
Fluent Arabic and English communication skills, written and spoken.
If you are a commercially minded HR leader who can build compliant, people-focused operations in a regulated financial-services environment, we welcome your application.

Strong understanding of brand positioning, market trends, customer engagement, and business development.
Excellent communication, leadership, and organizational skills.
Develop and implement marketing strategies aligned with company objectives.
Lead and supervise the marketing team to ensure effective execution of marketing plans.
Manage and maintain company profiles, social media accounts, and digital marketing activities.
Plan and execute marketing campaigns, promotions, and brand awareness initiatives.

d: Vodafone is Oman’s latest Network Operator. The presence of Vodafone in Oman will contribute to the development of all sectors, including the economic and educational sectors, and in line with Oman Vision 2040.

Our purpose is to ‘Connect for a Better Future ‘which underpins everything we do. Our solutions will positively impact society as we connect everyone in Oman for a better future. What we offer are market-leading customer experiences and innovative digital services.

We are looking for energetic self-starters to work in this 100% Omani owned, positive collaborative start-up environment, where key talents will create Oman’s happiest workplace. We are looking for individuals with an entrepreneurial mindset who get excited by challenges and constant change and truly want to positively impact the lives of our customers and the people of Oman.

As part of our Budget and Vendor Management team, we are looking for a Technology Financial Analyst to provide financial planning, analysis, control and reporting across the Technology function. The role will manage Capex and Opex tracking, budgeting, forecasting, purchase orders, invoices, accruals and vendor expenditure, enabling accurate financial decisions, strong governance and effective cost optimisation.
The role will work closely with Network, IT and Operations teams to ensure alignment between financial planning, technology requirements and operational priorities.
q: Strong financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting and management reporting capability.
Sound understanding of Capex, Opex, accruals, commitments, purchase orders and invoice lifecycle management.
High attention to detail, sound judgement and a control-focused mindset.
Ability to translate complex financial data into concise, actionable management insights.
Advanced stakeholder management and ability to work across Technology, Finance, Supply Chain and vendors.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and meet reporting deadlines.
Commercial awareness and a proactive cost-optimisation mindset.
Minimum 1 year of relevant experience in financial analysis, FP&A, management accounting or Technology finance.
Experience in telecommunications, IT, digital services or project-based environments is preferred.
Accuracy and timeliness of monthly Technology financial reporting and accrual submissions.
Forecast accuracy and quality of budget variance explanations.
Percentage of Technology expenditure maintained within approved budgets.
Timely reconciliation of open purchase orders, invoices, accruals and financial commitments.
Reduction in ageing commitments, delayed invoices and unutilised budget.
Value of cost savings, avoidance and optimisation opportunities identified.
Compliance with financial controls, procurement requirements and audit actions.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related discipline.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including financial modelling, PivotTables, lookups and reconciliations.
Experience with ERP and procurement systems such as SAP, Oracle or equivalent.
Power BI or similar business intelligence experience is preferred.
ACCA, CIMA, CMA, CPA, CFA or a similar professional certification is an advantage.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
